name: family-tree-editor
description: client-side family tree viewer and editor for the attu project wiki

scripts.server:dev: cd apps/server && uv run uvicorn attu_tree.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.server:lint: cd apps/server && uv run ruff check . && uv run basedpyright
scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test:unit && pnpm build && pnpm server:lint && pnpm server:test
